result.question: In the battles at Gob, who kills first?

readings.support: At that time Sibbekai the Hushathite killed Saph | In another battle with the Philistines at Gob

assessments.reason: Verse 18 describes the first battle at Gob where Sibbekai the Hushathite killed Saph, and verse 19 says in another battle at Gob Elhanan killed Goliath’s brother, so Sibbekai kills first.

result.reason: Verse 18 places Sibbekai’s kill in the first Gob battle, before Elhanan’s kill in another battle.
